Title: A Coarse-to-Fine Deformable Transformation Framework for Unsupervised Multi-Contrast MR Image Registration With Dual Consistency Constraint

Network: classical Matrix Factorization-based (TV-GNMF)
Objective: Frobenius norm + TV reg loss + graph reg loss
Dataset: Self (Brain MRI sequences, Harris Corner Detector feature points); ORL, PIE, COIL20, TDT2 for clustering
Findings: TV-GNMF enhances feature discrimination by combining TV constraint and graph regularization; improves clustering and registration accuracy; achieves stable one-to-one correspondences; outperforms NMF, TV-NMF, and GNMF in most cases; achieves robust matching with less computational overhead compared to CPD.
Title: Total Variation Constrained Non-Negative Matrix Factorization for Medical Image Registration

Sub Catagory: Nonlinear Diffusion Filtering, Speckle Noise Robust, Affine
Network: classical Detector-based (KAZE with Modified SURF Descriptor)
Metric: Precision, Recall, F-measure, TP counts, Computation Time
Dataset: Self (SAR images with different times, scales, noise levels, and viewpoints)
Findings: KAZE with modified SURF descriptor improves feature localization and robustness to speckle noise; handles complex affine transformations; outperforms SURF, MSER, and BRISK in F-measure, recall, and TP count; achieves successful SAR image registration with higher precision and accuracy.
Title: KAZE-SAR: SAR Image Registration Using KAZE Detector and Modified SURF Descriptor for Tackling Speckle Noise

Network: Unsupervised; ConvGRU-based CNN (Lung-CRNet)
Metric: TRE, % of negative Jacobian determinants, MAE
Findings: Lung-CRNet reduces TRE to 1.56 ± 1.05 mm, improves groupwise registration by leveraging temporal dependencies, and is faster than traditional and other deep learning methods.
Title: Lung-CRNet: A convolutional recurrent neural network for lung 4DCT image registration

Network: Weakly-Supervised; 3D V-Net for segmentation, U-Net-like architecture for registration
Dataset: Self (121 MR cases, 104 US cases for segmentation; 63 paired MR-US cases for registration)
Findings: Segmentation-based framework improves prostate MR-US registration for HDR brachytherapy; achieves DSC 0.87 ± 0.05, reduces manual effort, and aligns contours accurately under weak supervision.
Title: MR to ultrasound image registration with segmentation-based learning for HDR prostate brachytherapy

Sub Catagory: Multi-modal, Combined (SIFT + ResNet), High-Resolution Remote Sensing
Network: Supervised; ResNet34 and ResNet50 (fine-tuned on registered HR remote sensing image patches)
Dataset: Self (five pairs of multisource HR remote sensing images; GaoFen and QuickBird satellite datasets)
Findings: Combining ResNet with SIFT improves tie point count by 1.24–3.87x and RMSET by 32.1–53.7% compared to traditional SIFT and Patch-SIFT; achieves RMSET < 2 pixels for all datasets and < 0.5 pixels for urban areas.
Title: An Image Registration Method Using Deep Residual Network Features for Multisource High-Resolution Remote Sensing Images

Network: Supervised; MatchNet and GMatchNet (pretrained on remote sensing image patches)
Objective: Cross-entropy loss for MatchNet; objective cost function (𝜙) evaluation
Metric: RMSE (all and leave-one-out), Nred, cost function (𝜙), NCC
Dataset: Self (KOMPSAT-3 satellite images of Seoul and surrounding regions, multispectral RGB images)
Findings: Proposed framework reduces RMSE to 34.922 and improves matching accuracy by 68.4% over conventional frameworks; achieves precise registration by compensating geometric distortions with GMatchNet and fine-tuning local transformations.
Title: A CNN-Based High-Accuracy Registration for Remote Sensing Images

Network: classical Feature-based with SIFT descriptors and neighborhood topology constraints
Objective: Optimization cost function combining local topology, feature similarity, and regularization
Metric: Precision, Recall, RMSE, Number of Correct Matches (NCM)
Dataset: CIAP, UAV, SAR, SUIRD (custom and public datasets, includes diverse scenarios like low overlap and noise)
Findings: Two-step method combining local topology constraints and global affine transformations increases precision and recall; robust to noise and outliers; achieves high accuracy across diverse datasets
Title: A Two-Step Method for Remote Sensing Images Registration Based on Local and Global Constraints

Network: Unsupervised; Feature-based (Modified SIFT Framework)
Dataset: High-Resolution Orthoimagery (HRO) from USGS and EOS, including multispectral and multitemporal images; custom simulated datasets
Findings: TcHe-SIFT framework enhances feature matching efficiency and accuracy by combining a revised SIFT, stochastic competition for outlier removal, and homogeneity enforcement. It reduces RMSE and improves MI and CC compared to state-of-the-art SIFT-based methods.
Title: Automatic Registration of Remote Sensing Images Based on Revised SIFT With Trilateral Computation and Homogeneity Enforcement

Network: Unsupervised; Fully Convolutional Autoencoder
Objective: MSE + reg loss with β regularization
Metric: Avg Euclidean Distances, Landmark Location Errors
Dataset: Attica VHR (custom dataset from WorldView-2) and ISPRS Ikonos dataset
Findings: The proposed multistep deformable registration reduces landmark errors below 3 pixels and achieves efficient alignment on urban and periurban high-resolution datasets. Iterative refinement improves deformation accuracy compared to single-step methods.
Title: Unsupervised Multistep Deformable Registration of Remote Sensing Imagery Based on Deep Learning

Sub Catagory: Multi-modal, Fast, Robust, Control Point Matching
Network: classical Non-neural network; Block-based FAST + CFOG for feature extraction; RANSAC for outlier removal
Dataset: Sentinel-2 Multispectral (optical) and Sentinel-1 SAR images
Findings: The proposed system improves registration accuracy and speed for multimodal remote sensing images, achieving RMSE of 1.97 pixels, 22x faster than ENVI, and 2x faster than ERDAS. It provides robust CP matching under radiometric and geometric distortions.
Title: A Fast and Robust Matching System for Multimodal Remote Sensing Image Registration

Sub Catagory: Point Feature, Multi-modal, Two-dimensional, Fine Matching
Network: classical Harris corner + SIFT for feature extraction, BBF + KNN-TAR for rough and fine matching
Objective: Affine transform fitting + KNN-TAR affine invariance
Dataset: GF-1, GF-2, ASTER, and Multi-source (GF-1 + GF-2)
Findings: KNN-TAR improves false match elimination over RANSAC; the proposed algorithm improves registration accuracy compared to SIFT, SURF, ORB, and RANSAC for optical remote sensing imagery.
Title: Satellite-Borne Optical Remote Sensing Image Registration Based on Point Features

Network: classical Feature-based BWP model + Optical Flow (Brox) + Weighted Taylor Expansion
Objective: Weighted Taylor expansion with geometric distance and structural similarity terms
Findings: Region-by-region approach combining feature-based and optical flow methods improves registration accuracy across flat- and complex-terrain regions; achieves highest accuracy with minimal geometric misalignment and effective LULC correction.
Title: Region-by-Region Registration Combining Feature-Based and Optical Flow Methods for Remote Sensing Images

Sub Catagory: SAR Image Registration, Multi-source, Multi-pass, Multi-modal
Network: classical algorithmic-based approach using SAR-SIFT and RD model
Objective: geometric transformation estimation with least-square principle
Metric: CMR, RMSE, Distribution Quality (density and coverage measures)
Dataset: Self (Synthetic datasets using TerraSAR-X imaging parameters and real SAR datasets such as TerraSAR-X, Radarsat 2, Sentinel-1A, and Gaofen-3)
Findings: RD+SAR-SIFT combines SWT, RD model, and adaptive transformations to improve SAR image registration in terms of match accuracy, distribution, and computational efficiency. RD+SAR-SIFT improves registration for images with significant geometric distortions and achieves better global and local feature distributions compared to other SAR-SIFT variants.
Title: Combining Optimized SAR-SIFT Features and RD Model for Multisource SAR Image Registration

Network: Supervised, Single-Stage Fine-Grained (SSFG) Instance Segmentation Network
Objective: Focal Loss + Dice Loss + Binary Cross-Entropy Loss + Categorical Cross-Entropy Loss
Metric: RMSE, NOCC, ROCC, Dice, mIoU, WCov, BoundF
Findings: Instance segmentation improves accuracy and robustness in high-resolution remote sensing image registration; SSFG achieves superior boundary fineness and efficiency; reduces computational load by focusing on valid local features; copes with poor positioning accuracy effectively.
Title: An Instance Segmentation Based Framework for Large-Sized High-Resolution Remote Sensing Images Registration

Network: Supervised, ResNet-50
Dataset: ISPRS Drone Image Dataset; Pix4Dmapper Dataset; Self (Dayi County Farmlands, Wusufo Mountain Forests)
Findings: ResNet-50 features combined with PROSAC improve registration accuracy to subpixel levels; Kronecker product integration enhances feature vector effectiveness compared to bilinear interpolation or distance weighting; method is robust across varied UAV scenes with high resolutions.
Title: UAV Remote Sensing Image Automatic Registration Based on Deep Residual Features

Network: Supervised Conv Pyramid with global spatial attention module
Objective: Fusion = texture+ssim+intensity, Sementic=Lovasz-Softmax, Reg = phtometric+endpoint + consistency
Findings:
photometric and end-point losses can be used
 to improve precision
Title: SuperFusion: A Versatile Image Registration and Fusion Network with Semantic Awareness

Network: Unsupervised MU-Net
Dataset: self - WHU Building dataset, Landsat-8, GF3 and ZY3, Google map
Findings: method is robust to geometric and radiometric distortions between multimodal image pairs
Title: A Multiscale Framework With Unsupervised Learning for Remote Sensing Image Registration

Network: Unsupervised: RFNet (Deformable Conv + TransNet + AffineNet + F2M)
Findings: feedback from fusion greatly improves quality of fine-registred results
Title: RFNet: Unsupervised Network for Mutually Reinforcing Multi-modal Image Registration and Fusion

Network: Semisupervised and Unsupervised Vision Transformer (C2FViT)
Objective: NCC sim loss and Dice based seg loss
Dataset: OASIS (T1-weighted MRI) and LPBA (some in MNI152 coord system)
Findings: Superior performance in handling large initial misalignments and unseen datasets
Title: Affine Medical Image Registration with Coarse-to-Fine Vision Transformer

Network: Unsupervised Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) with Siren periodic activation functions
Objective: NCC + reg (jac det reg, hyperelastic reg, bending energy penalty)
Findings: Siren (periodic) activation functions allow high-frequency signal representation, capturing both small and large deformations.
Title: Implicit Neural Representations for Deformable Image Registration

Network: Unsupervised, Multi-Scale Encoder with Deformer Modules with Attention Mechanisms
Objective: Local NCC + Reg on displacement fields + aux loss at multi-scale levels
Findings: Multi-scale framework with auxiliary loss enhances coarse-to-fine displacement field learning and generates smooth deformation fields with minimal folding
Title: Deformer: Towards Displacement Field Learning for Unsupervised Medical Image Registration

Network: Unsupervised, Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model with a deformation network
Objective: diffusion loss + registraion loss (Local NCC + smooth penalty)
Metric: 2D Fae: NMSE, SSIM, negJDet%, 3D cardiac: DSC, PSNR, NMSE, negJDet%
Findings: topology preserving transform: continuous deformation along trajectories from moving to fixed images
Title: DiffuseMorph: Unsupervised Deformable Image Registration Using Diffusion Model

Network: Supervised, Attention based Deep Feature Correlation Learning Network (channel and spatial attn)
Metric: FPR95, mAP, RMSE, num Matches IR
Dataset: Brown Dataset, HPatches, VIS-NIR, Visible-LiDAR, Visible-SAR, Optical-SAR (custom)
Findings: Attention mechanism improves deep feature representation and image registration performance
Title: Deep Feature Correlation Learning for Multi-Modal Remote Sensing Image Registration

Network: classical (Gaussian Laplacian second-order differential operator)
Objective: NCC with Sobel and Log operators
Dataset: self DRR images for 2D, DICOM sequence from brain CT scans
Findings: introducing Sobel and LOG operators enhances edge and rotation sensitivity
Title: 2D/3D Multimode Medical Image Registration Based on Normalized Cross-Correlation

Network: Unsupervised; ResNet-based translation network ; U-Net-based registration network.
Objective: smooth + PatchNCE loss + Pixel loss (l1) + local alignment + global alignment
Dataset: Learn2Reg (Thorax-Abdomen CT-MR Dataset + Lung CT Dataset)
Findings: discriminator-free approach avoids inconsistency and artifacts seen in GAN-based methods
Title: Unsupervised Multi-Modal Medical Image Registration via Discriminator-Free Image-to-Image Translation

Network: supervised Transformer with U-Net-based dual feature extraction networks with cross attention
Findings: window-based cross attention produces robust cross-image correspondence
Title: XMorpher: Full Transformer for Deformable Medical Image Registration via Cross Attention

Network: supervised Feature Decoupling Network: contains residual denoising network + pseudo-siamese fully conv net
Objective: RDNet: MSE + Total variation; PSFCN: hard example mining loss SSD
Dataset: QXS-SAROPT Dataset, OS Dataset, SEN1-2 Dataset
Findings: feature decoupling strategy enables better extraction of semantic features by separating noise and content
Title: Optical and SAR Image Registration Based on Feature Decoupling Network

Sub Catagory: Symmetric Encoder-Decoder, Displacement Field, Diffeomorphic Registration
Network: unsupervised Symmetric Convolution-based Efficient Multi-Head Self-Attention-based Transformer
Findings: CEMSA enhances spatial and semantic correspondence; symm arch improves anatomical consistency
Title: Symmetric Transformer-based Network for Unsupervised Image Registration

Network: unsupervised symmetric 3D Swin-UNet
Objective: sim loss (MSE) + smooth reg + jac det reg + inverse consistency loss
Findings: Focuses on topology preservation and invertibility, making it suitable for critical medical imaging tasks
Title: Swin-VoxelMorph: A Symmetric Unsupervised Learning Model for Deformable Medical Image Registration Using Swin Transformer

Sub Catagory: Recursive, Multi-level Pyramid, Diffeomorphic and Non-Diffeomorphic
Network: supervised Recursive Decomposition Network (stage wise + level wise recursion)
Objective: dissimilarity loss + reg loss + velocity reg
Findings: stage-wise and level-wise recursion obtains efficient and sufficient decomposition
Title: Recursive Decomposition Network for Deformable Image Registration

Network: Unsupervised; Geometry-Consistent Adversarial Registration Framework with sei-shared multi-scale network
Objective: L1 recon loss +LSGAN loss + smooth loss
Findings: Geometry-consistent training decouples spatial deformation and modality mapping, improving accuracy
Title: Geometry-Consistent Adversarial Registration Model for Unsupervised Multi-Modal Medical Image Registration

Network: Unsupervised; Dual-head deformation field network based on UNet + ResNet
Objective: MAE sim loss + smooth reg loss + cycle consistency + GAN loss
Dataset: BraTS (T1-T2MRI), Clinical head and neck ct-mri dataset
Findings: collaborative cycle-consistency framework unifies multi-modal image registration and translation
Title: CoCycleReg: Collaborative cycle-consistency method for multi-modal medical image registration

Sub Catagory: Patch-based, Multi-modal, Unified Framework for Registration and Segmentation
Network: Unsupervised;  VoxelMorph + Swin Transformer integration
Objective: NCC + l2 diffusion reg + patchwise contrastibe loss
Findings: Introduces patch-based contrastive and stitching strategies to improve feature representation and eliminate patch artifacts
Title: PC-SwinMorph: Patch Representation for Unsupervised Medical Image Registration and Segmentation

Network: classical: steerable filters and feature extraction
Dataset: Optical-to-Infrared: Daedalus (optical and infrared), QuickBird; LiDAR-to-Optical: LiDAR intensity, WorldView-2 optical; Optical-to-SAR: Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2, TerraSAR-X; Optical-to-Map: Google Maps imagery (self)
Findings: Proposed method combines first- and second-order steerable filters for robust multimodal image feature extraction
Title: A Robust Multimodal Remote Sensing Image Registration Method and System Using Steerable Filters with First- and Second-Order Gradients

Network: Supervised: Self-Distillation Network (SDNet)
Objective: matching loss (triplet + hard neg mining) + self-dist consistency loss (kldiv) + recon loss (mse)
Metric: FPR95, Acc, RMSE, transform error, matching prob
Findings: model achieves high registration accuracy and smooth alignment in various environmental conditions
Title: Self-Distillation Feature Learning Network for Optical and SAR Image Registration

Network: Unsupervised: hierarchical CNN encoder + im2grid network
Findings: Coordinate Translator effectively decouples feature extraction and coordinate correspondence, improving performance.
Title: Coordinate Translator for Learning Deformable Medical Image Registration

Network: Supervised: VLSG-SANet, Siamese network with attention modules
Findings: Siamese framework to dynamically adjust feature descriptors.
Title: VLSG-SANet: A Feature Matching Algorithm for Remote Sensing Image Registration

Sub Catagory: Multiscale, Multimodal, Robust to Intensity, Rotation, and Scale Differences
Network: classical (Harris corner detection and GGLOH descriptor)
Findings: Multiscale strategy enhances feature robustness and matching performance
Title: MS-HLMO: Multiscale Histogram of Local Main Orientation for Remote Sensing Image Registration

Network: Unsupervised; VoxelMorph-based architecture with Cross-Resolution Distillation
Findings: Proposed scheme enables low-resolution models to achieve performance competitive with high-resolution models.
Title: Cross-Resolution Distillation for Efficient 3D Medical Image Registration

Network: Supervised; E2e-Varnet + residual unet
Objective: mag + phase symm loss + ssim loss
Metric: SSiM, PSNR, VIF, Phase MSE, Endpoint error
Findings: orth-loss generalized beyond MRI reconstruction to image registration, outperforming EPE loss in registration accuracy
Title: A Symmetric Loss Function for Magnetic Resonance Imaging Reconstruction and Image Registration with Deep Learning

Network: Unsupervised; Transformer-UNet (TUNet), a hybrid of Vision Transformer (VIT) and UNet with bi-level connections
Findings: bi-level connections in TUNet improve information flow, enhancing registration performance.
Title: A Transformer-based Network for Deformable Medical Image Registration

Network: Unsupervised; Self-Distilled Hierarchical Network
Findings: self-deformation distillation scheme significantly improves intermediate and final deformation field accuracy without increasing inference time
Title: Self-Distilled Hierarchical Network for Unsupervised Deformable Image Registration

Network: Supervised, DenseNet with Self-Attention, Spatial Transformer Network
Objective: Dual-Supervised Loss (Mean Squared Error, Normalized Mutual Information)
Findings: dual-supervised loss combining point displacement and pixel alignment metrics  achieves high accuracy
Title: Multimodal Image Fusion Framework for End-to-End Remote Sensing Image Registration

Network: Unsupervised, Transformer-based hybrid with CNN, U-Net-like
Findings: Combining the global modeling capability of Transformer and local modeling of CNN for deformable medical image registration improves performance
Title: TD-Net: Unsupervised Medical Image Registration Network Based on Transformer and CNN

Network: Unsupervised, AAN-enhanced deep learning registration methods
Objective: Intensity MSE + Local CC + anatomy constrained loss
Dataset: Training: ADNI, ABIDE, ADHD, IXI,  Testing: IBSR18, Mindboggle101, LPBA40
Findings: Appearance Adjustment Network enhance DLRs by reducing appearance variations while preserving anatomical structures.
Title: Enhancing Medical Image Registration via Appearance Adjustment Networks

Network: Unsupervised, VoxelMorph with a predictive uncertainty branch
Dataset: Hippocampus MRI dataset, Prostate MRI dataset
Findings: Outperforms VoxelMorph in both registration metrics (e.g., NLCC and Dice) and uncertainty metrics (AUSE).
Title: Uncertainty Learning towards Unsupervised Deformable Medical Image Registration

Network: Unsupervised; Cross-Domain Fusion Registration Network
Dataset: Self (Clinical CT-to-CBCT dataset from 48 patients with 191 image pairs)
Findings: Edge-Guided Attention Module (EGAM) to capture edge information and  Cross-Domain Attention Module (CDAM) maps and fuses domain-specific features
Title: CDFRegNet: A cross-domain fusion registration network for CT-to-CBCT image registration

Network: Unsupervised; Dual Attention VoxelMorph
Objective: NCC + Spatial smoothness with bending reg
Findings: dual attention (spatial and coordinate attention) for improves feature focus and suppression of irrelevant regions
Title: Dual attention network for unsupervised medical image registration based on VoxelMorph

Network: Unsupervised; Neural Ordinary Differential Equation-based optimization
Findings: improves registration quality (higher Dice) while maintaining diffeomorphic properties (lower rD and sD)
Title: NODEO: A Neural Ordinary Differential Equation Based Optimization Framework for Deformable Image

Network: Supervised; Cross-modal attention-based neural network
Objective: rigid: MSE deformable: DSC loss + smooth diffusion optimizer
Findings: model effectively handles both rigid and deformable registration tasks
Title: Cross-modal attention for multi-modal image registration

Objective: Regularized + ground truth labels; Cross-Correlation (CC) for similarity
Metric: Accuracy + Specificity + Sensitivity + F-measure + DSC + Hausdorff Distance + Symmetric Surface Distance
Findings: MCST improves feature extraction and SADNN reduces uncertainty in registration results
Title: An optimal self-adaptive deep neural network and spine-kernelled chirplet transform for image registration

Network: Supervised; Joint Synthesis and Registration (JSR) Network with multi-resolution registration decoder and shared encoder architecture
Objective: Adversarial loss + L1 loss + structural-consistency loss + inter-modality image similarity loss + deformation smoothness regularization
Dataset: Self (50 simulated MR-CBCT image pairs with synthetic deformations; 14 clinical MR-CBCT image pairs with real deformations)
Findings: multi-resolution decoder improves alignment compared to single-resolution models
Title: Joint synthesis and registration network for deformable MR-CBCT image registration for neurosurgical guidance

Network: Unsupervised; Contrastive Learning Framework with VoxelMorph-style U-Net and multi-scale embeddings
Objective: Contrastive loss + Local NCC + L1 loss + Reg loss (velocity smoothness)
Findings: ContraReg improves registration accuracy and robustness on T1w-T2w MRI with higher Dice and lower deformation irregularities
Title: ContraReg: Contrastive Learning of Multi-modality Unsupervised Deformable Image Registration

Network: Unsupervised; Hierarchical Cumulative Network (HCN) with Bidirectional Asymmetric Registration Module (BARM)
Dataset: OASIS, LPBA, Learn2Reg 2021 Task 3 as vaql set
Findings: BARM enhances registration accuracy by learning two asymmetric DVFs to warp images along the geodesic path; hierarchical recursion decomposes deformations at multiple scales, capturing finer details for large deformations
Title: Hierarchical Cumulative Network for Unsupervised Medical Image Registration

Network: Unsupervised; Multi-Strategy Mutual Learning Network (MMLN)
Objective: Correlation coefficient loss + reg loss (spatial gradient L2 norm)
Findings: mutual learning framework integrates 3D and 2D registration networks to extract global and local features, enhancing registration accuracy in multi-region medical images
Title: Multi-Strategy Mutual Learning Network for Deformable Medical Image Registration

Network: Supervised; Pseudo-Siamese Network (SARPointNet)
Objective: Feature detector loss (Lossp) + Descriptor loss (Lossd) + Descriptor contrast loss (Losscp)
Dataset: Self (SAR-registration dataset with scenarios in Hubei Province: mountain, hilly, flatland, urban)
Findings: SARPointNet improves registration robustness; extracts more keypoints (10x other methods in some scenarios) with RMSE < 1 pixel; handles speckle noise and geometric deformation effectively.
Title: SARPointNet: An Automated Feature Learning Framework for Spaceborne SAR Image Registration

Network: classical Not applicable; feature-based method using vascular bifurcations
Findings: Proposed method improves accuracy in fundus registration by distributing feature points uniformly over vascular structures and matching HOG-based descriptors; achieves AUC of 0.526 for the FIRE dataset.
Title: A Straightforward Bifurcation Pattern-Based Fundus Image Registration Method

Network: classical Not applicable; feature-based method using modified SIFT
Metric: F-score, Precision, Recall, RMSE, MAE, MEE, STD
Dataset: Self; 35 lung adenocarcinoma tissue whole slide image pairs
Findings: Proposed method increases matching accuracy with reduced mismatches; achieves 95% matching rate, high F-score (96.16%), and low RMSE (0.4631) compared to state-of-the-art methods like SIFT and MS-SIFT.
Title: Whole slide image registration via multi-stained feature matching

Network: Unsupervised; Recursive Cascade Network with pre-trained U-Net for segmentation
Objective: Similarity loss + Total variation reg loss + Contrast concentration loss + Ventricle alignment loss
Metric: Dice Score, Hausdorff Distance, SSIM, Mutual Information, Histogram similarity (CCF, HeD, ChiS)
Dataset: Self (118 patient dynamic CT myocardial perfusion dataset with 944 2D sequences and contrast agent masks)
Findings: LCV improves spatial alignment metrics and preserves HU values essential for perfusion; LCV outperforms iterative methods in speed and accuracy while reducing artifacts; contrast concentration loss enhances registration without degrading image quality
Title: Deep Learning-Based Image Registration in Dynamic Myocardial Perfusion CT Imaging

Network: supervised Graph-cut-based deformable registration combined with SimpleElastix affine registration
Objective: Weighted cost function with SSD + Pearson correlation
Metric: Dice Coefficients, Mean Intensity Magnitude Error, Vector Magnitude Error, Jacobian determinant, registration time
Dataset: Self (131 cHL PET-CT scans and 135 HNC longitudinal PET-CT scans)
Findings: Stepwise registration improves point-correspondence between whole-body PET-CT images, robust to tumor regions and intensity inhomogeneities; handles between- and within-subject registration with mean VME < 5 mm and Dice > 0.85
Title: An Image Registration Method for Voxel-Wise Analysis of Whole-Body Oncological PET-CT

Network: classical Not applicable (non-neural network-based method using feature detection and description techniques)
Dataset: Google Earth, GF-2 optical images, TerraSAR-X, GF-3, airborne SAR images; some synthetic datasets with noise and intensity variations
Findings: NDHL improves feature detection repeatability for SAR and optical images. MABPC enhances robustness against geometric and nonlinear intensity variations. Proposed method outperforms OS-SIFT, ROS-PC, and RIFT in terms of CM and RMSE, achieving a 54.6% improvement in correct matches and an average registration precision of 1.38 pixels.
Title: A Novel Multiscale Adaptive Binning Phase Congruency Feature for SAR and Optical Image Registration

Objective: Structural feature similarity loss (L_fc) + sparse structural constraints loss (L_kp) + reg loss
Metric: rTRE (relative Target Registration Error); Median rTRE, Average rTRE; robustness metrics

Findings: SFG improves non-rigid registration performance for histological images; dense and sparse components enhance global and local structural information; multi-scale features overcome challenges like staining variance, repetitive textures, and section missing.
Title: Unsupervised Histological Image Registration Using Structural Feature Guided Convolutional Neural Network

MedRegNet: unsupervised multimodal retinal-image registration with GANs and ranking loss

Objective: Energy functional including similarity term (gray scale distribution) + reg loss + uncertainty handling
Metric: MSE, NCC, SS, MI, FSIM, MAE

Findings: Diffeomorphic mapping improves registration accuracy and robustness for both same-modal and cross-modal images; handles large deformations effectively; outperforms some DL-based methods like Voxel-Morph and LT-Net.
Title: Toward Computing Cross-Modality Symmetric Non-Rigid Medical Image Registration

Objective: NCC loss + Dice loss + gradient-based diffusion regularization

TM-TVFLDDMM produces invertible and diffeomorphic transformations but suffers from performance reduction due to excessive regularization.
Title: Unsupervised Learning of Diffeomorphic Image Registration via TransMorph

Objective: N/A (Similarity metrics like MI, NMI, MSE, and CC are used for optimization)

Findings: FABER achieves up to 54x speedup and 177x energy efficiency over state-of-the-art solutions; IoU improves up to 0.97 compared to MATLAB and SimpleITK; customizable toolchain for diverse user expertise levels.
Title: Faber: A Hardware/Software Toolchain for Image Registration

Objective: Cross-correlation between skeletonized contours; constrained optimization problem
Dataset: Self (Real satellite images with optical and SAR data in agricultural areas)
Findings: Proposed variational approach improves co-registration accuracy between SAR and optical images by reducing sensitivity to noise and geometric distortions; selective smoothing enhances feature extraction; contour alignment avoids dependency on geometric similarity.
Title: Variational approach for rigid co-registration of optical/SAR satellite images in agricultural areas

Network: classical Modified RIFT with homomorphic filtering and binary pattern string descriptors
Objective: Descriptor matching loss; second-order transformation residual loss
Metric: RMSE, number of correct corresponding points, qualitative visual accuracy
Dataset: Self (SDGSAT-1 TIS images, Landsat 8, GF1-WFV, and SRTM data)
Findings: Modified RIFT improves TIR-visible registration robustness to non-linear radiance differences and noise; binary pattern descriptors enhance computational efficiency; orthorectification framework ensures accurate geo-referencing for SDGSAT-1 TIS images.
Title: A TIR-Visible Automatic Registration and Geometric Correction Method for SDGSAT-1 Thermal Infrared Image Based on Modified RIFT

Dataset: Landsat-8 (Self-generated datasets: NN, SN, DATe datasets with synthetic displacements and noise)
Findings: CNN-DATe improves sub-pixel displacement estimation with MAE below 0.1 pixel; outperforms PCC in precision and approaches COSI-Corr performance on synthetic data; synthetic datasets with realistic perturbations enhance model robustness.
Title: SUB-PIXEL OPTICAL SATELLITE IMAGE REGISTRATION FOR GROUND DEFORMATION USING DEEP LEARNING

Findings: Siamese network improves outlier detection accuracy over RANSAC, achieves better registration accuracy in single-sensor images; shows reduced performance in multi-sensor registration due to insufficient training data.
